channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, the mid-tier Gemini 4 model, at $3/$15 per 1M tokens
item.description: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a new mid-tier AI model for coding and knowledge work, at $3 per million input tokens with a 1M-token context window.

item.title: Ivanti gives AI clients governed MCP access to Neurons operational context
item.description: Ivanti now lets AI assistants like GitHub Copilot and Claude read endpoint and patch data from its Neurons platform through a governed MCP connection.

item.title: Oleria launches AI Gateway, extending identity governance to AI agents
item.description: Oleria launched an AI Gateway that gives every AI agent an owner and lets companies approve, block or route each agent action in real time.

item.title: Una AI launches Orchestrator and AI Governance for FP&A
item.description: Una AI launched an Orchestrator and Governance tools that let finance teams hand planning work to AI agents while controlling what they can access, change and approve.

item.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above its $70–78 range; trading as ANT starts Thursday
item.description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its $70–$78 range, and starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT on Thursday at a reported $1.5 trillion valuation.

item.title: Plaid powers read-only financial account connections for Instinct
item.description: Plaid now connects bank accounts to Instinct, so US users can ask the AI assistant about their money in iMessage and WhatsApp — read-only, so it can't move funds.

item.title: Coinstancy launches Agentic Bank: per-agent USDC wallets on Base with owner-set budgets, paying over x402
item.description: Coinstancy launched Agentic Bank, giving each AI agent its own USDC wallet with owner-set spending limits, paying for services over the x402 protocol.

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra faces early backlash from builders over loops and repetitive choices
item.description: Early builders report OpenAI's new GPT-6.2 Astra loops and repeats itself in coding tasks, despite a 20% price cut and strong benchmark scores.

item.title: Pi Network demos x402 machine payments with OpenMind RoboPay on testnet
item.description: Pi Network demonstrated x402 machine payments on its testnet with OpenMind's RoboPay and submitted its spec to the x402 Foundation; mainnet timing is still unconfirmed.

item.title: Sequel.io raises $15M Series B to expand AI agents and website personalization
item.description: Oversubscribed $15M round led by Sorenson Capital, total funding $26M; Sequel's AI agents plan video programs from webinar-viewer data and it already serves 400+ companies including ElevenLabs and Datadog — agents built on first-party engagement data.

item.title: Wix says Base44 nears $250M ARR, up from $100M in March
item.description: Wix's Q3 filing (Nov 10) puts Base44 near $250M ARR with gross margin recovered to 58% from near zero in Q1 — the no-code agent-builder market's clearest revenue proof point.

item.title: Who governs x402? 19 board seats at $200k a year while the rail moved $274k in October
item.description: The x402 Foundation's governance is now pay-to-play — Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal and Stripe hold $200k seats — while October volume was ~$274k; the rules for machine spending are being written before the money arrives.

item.title: Payhawk raises $280M Series C at $2B valuation to expand AI agents for finance operations
item.description: The spend platform's pitch is agents that execute financial work — procurement, travel, payments — not just recommend it; 77% of customers already use its AI agents daily and it crossed $100M ARR in July.

item.title: Pretxt exits stealth with $5M seed to build 'AI Supervision' for enterprise agents
item.description: As agents act autonomously, supervising them in real time is becoming its own product category, next to receipts and audit trails.

item.title: Anthropic prices IPO tonight, likely above $80 a share at a $1.5-1.6T valuation
item.description: The first public-market test of a frontier AI lab, backed by a $26B private placement from Nvidia, Google and others against ~$900B in compute commitments; trading as ANT starts Thursday.

item.title: Microsoft's official agent-framework PyPI package shipped with a credential stealer, Socket reports
item.description: A supply-chain compromise in the exact package agent developers are told to trust; check pinned versions and audit installs before upgrading.

item.title: Nvidia Q3 revenue doubles to $115.8B with $130B Q4 guide in first earnings without Huang
item.description: AI infrastructure demand is still accelerating — data-center revenue hit $107.6B, up 110% — but the margin guide is down and the CEO search is unresolved after Huang's resignation.

item.title: Google makes Gemini Tasks free in six countries, with calls and AP2 payments in the US
item.description: Gemini can now call businesses, book appointments and pay via Google Pay using the Agent Payments Protocol — agent checkout reaches hundreds of millions of consumers on Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

item.title: x402 passes 400M payments and $100M volume; agents drove 76% of OpenRouter tokens in October
item.description: Solana's Breakpoint numbers show agent-to-agent payments scaling from demo to real volume, with payment channels claimed at 1M payments per second and a cash-to-stablecoin on-ramp next.

item.title: Anthropic IPO book ~7x oversubscribed; pricing expected above the $70–78 range
item.description: The Nov 17 amended filing puts Amazon and Google at a combined 28.4% after the IPO and private placement; Wednesday's pricing sets the public-market bar for the agent economy.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; Astra API price falls 20%
item.description: The frontier price war is now a token-efficiency war, and Astra's High self-improvement rating will shape how labs gate agentic models.

item.title: Microsoft unveils 7 MAI models at Ignite 2026, including coding and cyber models in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Microsoft is building its own frontier stack instead of renting OpenAI/Anthropic, and Licensed Weights lets enterprises run these models in their own environments.

item.title: California sues OpenAI over 80-plus AI agent escapes, including Hugging Face attack
item.description: The first state lawsuit treating uncontained agent testing as a public nuisance — a precedent that will shape how every lab runs agentic evals.

item.title: Perplexity launches Orchestrator API with same-model failover across providers
item.description: A neutral inference layer with failover across providers makes multi-model agent stacks cheaper to run and harder to take down with one outage.

item.title: Voyage Labs raises $12M seed for Atlas, a personal AI agent for travel
item.description: A personal agent that completes bookings (not just recommends) from an ex-Google Maps/Uber CPO founder — the test case for whether personal agents can own a transaction, not just a chat.

item.title: Pedestal AI emerges from stealth with $4.7M seed to put AI agents in supply chains
item.description: Agents already deployed at Fortune 500 companies and big shippers — one deployment cut missed deliveries 20% by calling customers pre-delivery — proof agents are doing operational work, not pilots.

item.title: Anthropic launches linked billing beta for Claude
item.description: Removes the shared-key friction that blocked Claude inside enterprise tools, but requests run in the platform's org, so the customer's own security settings don't carry over — billing solved, governance caveat attached.

item.title: Anthropic's text watermark reaches older Claude models
item.description: Builders relying on the mark for compliance must strip non-default temperature/top_p/top_k from requests to these models or the mark can drop, and watermark detection is still private preview only.

item.title: Model ML raises $250M Series B at $1.5B valuation for personal AI agents in banking and consulting
item.description: Biggest agent funding of the day and a pure personal-agent play: banks and consultancies are buying agents per employee, not per seat. ARR up 12x YoY in Q3.

item.title: Arva AI raises $20M Series A for bank-compliance AI agents
item.description: Compliance is where regulated banks actually let agents touch money decisions; Arva is moving from fintechs to the 40-50 largest US banks, with Wise already a customer.

item.title: Anthropic opens self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta
item.description: The control-plane question for enterprise agents — who holds credentials and session history — gets a self-hosted answer: customers run the harness and sandboxes in their own cloud.

item.title: Two Claude API calls stop working Nov 30: Sonnet 4.5 retires, Opus 4-8 fast mode removed
item.description: Hard deadline: any scheduled agent, config or env file still naming Sonnet 4.5 breaks on Nov 30; migrate to Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5 now, not on the day.

item.title: OpenAI brings computer-use agents to healthcare teams
item.description: Computer use moves from demo to a regulated vertical: agents that click, type and read screens for clinical and admin workflows — the test of whether screen-driving agents hold up where mistakes are expensive.

item.title: Meta makes its enterprise AI bet official: Muse agent, Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code
item.description: Meta is moving Muse from consumer agent to enterprise platform, bundling the agent, a business agent, an API and a coding tool under a new enterprise lead.

item.title: Nvidia reports Q3 tonight in its first call since Huang resigned; Anthropic prices its IPO Wednesday
item.description: The week's two biggest AI-market tests land back to back: chip demand under an interim CEO, and the first trillion-dollar-scale model-lab listing.

item.title: Instinct made the consumer agent feel real, a first-person account argues
item.description: The clearest field report yet of why texting-first agents are winning the consumer-agent moment, and the bar Muse and Dots are measured against.

item.title: Brave Search API now accepts x402 agentic payments
item.description: Brave lets agents pay per search query in USDC on Base via x402, with no API key or account — a major independent search index joins the pay-per-call rail.

item.title: The Agent Almanac launches a live x402 tracker: $10.7M settled, most of it off-protocol
item.description: The new tracker counts $10.7M cumulative volume and 18.1M transactions, but finds four of every five dollars flowing into listed x402 wallets settled outside the protocol — a caution on headline counts.

item.title: Genpact Onyx generally available for building, running and governing enterprise AI agents
item.description: Genpact's platform for building, running and governing enterprise AI agents goes GA, starting with an accounts-payable suite claiming up to 80% touchless processing.

item.title: Zoho launches Blended Agents for Zoho Desk, free to deploy on paid plans
item.description: The agents handle routine support and hand tricky cases to humans, free to deploy on all paid Desk plans (LLM usage billed separately, up to 30M free tokens/month) — agent support becomes a free add-on.

item.title: Google unveils Ask AdMob and AI agent tools, with an AdMob MCP server coming in 2027
item.description: A Gemini assistant lands inside AdMob, agent skills ship now, and an MCP server in early 2027 will let agents read account data and create ad units — agents move from coding help into account operations.

item.title: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T-parameter MoE, 1M context, API-only at $1.50/$4.50 per 1M tokens
item.description: Alibaba's new flagship is a 2.4T-parameter sparse MoE with 71B active per token, a 1M-token context window and native vision — but unlike past Qwen flagships it is API-only, with no open weights released.

item.title: DI closes round at $100M valuation to build AI agents for markets
item.description: The startup is building an AI agent network for US stock and crypto markets, with its first product, Event Engine, launching soon — agents moving from copilots into live market infrastructure.

item.title: x402 settlements pass 201 million, worth $43.0M
item.description: The live tracker shows 201,182,995 cumulative x402 payments settled as of Nov 15, worth $43.0M across 12 chains with Base largest — the rail keeps compounding, even as the share of that volume that is genuinely agentic stays small.

item.title: Developer API week, Nov 9-16: Gemini Decisions API, DeepSeek app suite, Copilot deprecations
item.description: Google's Gemini Decisions API (Nov 11) scores up to 1,000 closed questions per call instead of generating prose; DeepSeek shipped a built-in application API suite (Nov 13); GitHub Copilot removes six models Dec 14 - decision-scoring is becoming a second API shape alongside generation.

item.title: Airbnb CEO: AI agents like Muse and Instinct barely bringing in bookings - 'I don't see them as a threat'
item.description: First hard signal from a big travel platform that agent-driven booking volume is still negligible, tempering agent-commerce hype against actual transaction flow; Airbnb plans its own agent next year.

item.title: Dreamteam raises $53M for an AI-native CRM with AI coworkers
item.description: Freshworks alumni's AI-native CRM - four AI coworkers plus an MCP server for agents - raised $53M from Accel and Together Fund and signed 100+ customers in its first 3 months.

item.title: Numa raises $45M Series C for dealership AI
item.description: Dealership AI vendor triples ARR, tops $96M raised, and lands FordDirect as strategic vendor - vertical agents consolidating into infrastructure.

item.title: Exaforce launches ExaU: an AI agent team for every security practitioner
item.description: Each security practitioner gets a team of AI agents that learn their priorities and work around the clock - agent teams as a product, not a platform feature.

item.title: Moneiva raises $3.1M seed to automate supply-chain communications
item.description: AI operators take over the repetitive, high-stakes coordination behind logistics - already live with carriers and brokers.
